name: observe-agents-do-things
description: Watch Claude Code and Codex agents work in real time — a read-only observer with a clean event API and swappable frontends.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:web
scripts.build:packages: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/core packages/client packages/react packages/server
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace apps/web && node scripts/copy-ui.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/core packages/client packages/react packages/server && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace examples/react-dashboard && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/vscode && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/desktop
scripts.build:vscode: npm run build && npm run package --workspace apps/vscode
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm run dev --workspace apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run build --workspace apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:build && npm run package --workspace apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:build && npm run dist --workspace apps/desktop
